premises.text: Emerging technology and AI are seeking to replace humans.
premises.evidence_span: Emerging technology and AI are seeking to replace humans.

premises.text: Half of the world's population is connected via smartphones.
premises.evidence_span: half of us are connected via smartphones.

premises.text: Current technology limits our reach via social graphs.
premises.evidence_span: we're indexed by technology by our relationships.

premises.text: Human conversation is needed for better connections and opportunities.
premises.evidence_span: what we really need is human conversation.

premises.text: Sensei matches users with humans for conversation and advice.
premises.evidence_span: Sensei will match you with an awesome human to chat with.

premises.text: Sensei's natural language processing understands context and intent.
premises.evidence_span: Sensei's natural language processing understands both the context and the intent behind our need.

premises.text: Sensei is anonymous by default but allows information exchange when trust is established.
premises.evidence_span: Sensei is anonymous by default. But we are exchanging information when there's trust.

premises.text: Sensei's machine learning improves with more interactions.
premises.evidence_span: our machine learning is incredibly hungry for data.

premises.text: Sensei operates as a community cross-platform for conversation and commerce.
premises.evidence_span: Sensei is a community cross-platform of awesome humans.

premises.text: Sensei is launching globally on multiple platforms.
premises.evidence_span: Sensei is going global, launching in line, WeChat, and Skype in beta.

value.text: Users can connect and transact with humans for advice and opportunities.
value.evidence_span: It's a conversation marketplace in which users transact and chat commerce.

notes: No separate premises for user ratings and transaction metrics as they are evidence of traction.
